title: Duplicate messages are possible
summary: Message delivery can repeat. A consumer should recognise an event it has already handled.
introduction: Message delivery can repeat. A consumer should recognise an event it has already handled. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Message delivery can repeat. A consumer should recognise an event it has already handled.

blocks.code:
Receive event 81: increase count; remember 81
Receive event 81 again: ignore duplicate
Count increases once
blocks.title: Duplicate messages are possible

blocks.text: Remembering handled IDs avoids double counting. The storage and cleanup rule for IDs must be planned.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Trace events 81, 82, 81 and count the new events.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not assume every event arrives exactly once.
For more detail later, use this [Microservices further reading](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/microservices/).
